ws_audit_policy.title: Audit Policy
values: Vendors with 'grace period' noted in the Notes column are temporarily exempt from non-compliance flagging until the grace period expires. Do not report these vendors as non-compliant.
Vendors with Notes indicating a renewal has been submitted or is pending are exempt from flagging. They are in the process of renewing their documentation.
Rows with Notes containing 'VOIDED' must be ignored entirely. Use the non-voided record for that vendor instead.
Vendors with Notes indicating a 'pending legal review' must not be flagged as non-compliant until the legal review is resolved. Treat these as exempt.

If a recent email from compliance@company.example.com grants an extension or updates a vendor's compliance status, that email takes precedence over the spreadsheet data. Always check inbox for the latest compliance updates before finalizing the audit.
